meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "search memory", "what do you remember about X", "check claude-mem", "mem search", "find past observations", "what did we do last session", or wants prior-session context about a project, decision, file, or task. Searches the user's Claude-Mem (cmem.ai) memory.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 调出过往对话里与目标相关的记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常开多个会话，想搜回过往聊过的人、事或结论，免去重复询问。
copy.tagline_en: Pull up relevant records from your past conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often run many sessions and want to recall people, tasks, or conclusions from past chats.

howto.what: 装好后 Claude 能检索你存在 Claude-Mem(cmem.ai)里的记忆——由过往会话汇总成的带时间戳观察记录,覆盖 Claude Code、Cowork 等多个 agent;它用平实语言作答,问时间时会引用时间戳。
howto.when: 当你要求「search memory」、问「关于 X 你记得什么」或想知道上次会话做了什么,以及需要某个项目、决定、文件或任务的过往上下文时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜记忆里关于这个项目的记录
say.note: 先跑一趟宽泛关键词检索

say.text: 上次会话我们做了什么?
say.note: 汇总过往会话的观察记录

say.text: 查一下 claude-mem 里这个报错的记录
say.note: 用确切词再窄化检索一次

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude searches your Claude-Mem (cmem.ai) memory: timestamped observations from past sessions across Claude Code, Cowork and other agents. It answers in plain language and quotes timestamps when asked when.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to "search memory", "what do you remember about X", or "what did we do last session", or when you want prior-session context on a project, decision, file or task.

say_en.text: Search my memory for notes about this project
say_en.note: Runs a broad keyword search first

say_en.text: What did we do last session?
Look up this error in claude-mem
say_en.note: Narrows with a more specific term
